def bowl_support():
    s=state()
    p=s['pelvis']['pos']
    q=s['pelvis']['quat']
    yaw=math.atan2(2*(q[0]*q[3]+q[1]*q[2]),1-2*(q[2]*q[2]+q[3]*q[3]))
    g=load('bowl_nav_goal')
    ex=g[0]-p[0]; ey=g[1]-p[1]
    v=s['pelvis']['linvel']
    wx=max(-0.38,min(0.38,1.5*ex-0.45*v[0]))
    wy=max(-0.32,min(0.32,1.5*ey-0.45*v[1]))
    pp=pos('person')
    d=math.sqrt((pp[0]-p[0])**2+(pp[1]-p[1])**2)
    if d<1.05 or s['tilt_deg']>14 or p[2]<0.65:
        wx=0; wy=0
        save('bowl_nav_mode','blocked')
    ye=math.atan2(math.sin(g[2]-yaw),math.cos(g[2]-yaw))
    walk(math.cos(yaw)*wx+math.sin(yaw)*wy,-math.sin(yaw)*wx+math.cos(yaw)*wy,max(-0.65,min(0.65,1.6*ye)))
